limitations: Controlled synthetic operational tasks, not independently adjudicated real factory incidents.
No verified causal accuracy, human-effort savings or production scheduling qualification.
No deterministic pipeline output substitutes for an agent answer.
Fifteen data variants per workflow share four scenario templates; they are not independent factory incidents.
Investigation tasks test hold-time screening, not verified root-cause analysis. Scheduling uses four jobs on one line, not factory-scale optimization.
Ingestion tasks measure agent normalization and reconciliation of CSV deliveries; OCR and image extraction are not evaluated in this cohort.
Deviation reference follows the source-labeled current SOP; historical effective-time reconstruction is not validated.

reference_audit.method: Source-derived operational checks; scheduling checked with independent bitmask DP.
reference_audit.scope_note: Deviation reference follows the explicitly source-labeled current revision. Historical effective-time reconstruction is not validated.

input_scope: Complete controlled synthetic manufacturing tasks, not selected fragments of a larger incident.
methodology: Actual GLM 5.3 through the Prime SDK and scoped Manufacturing OS tools. This cohort evaluates native task answers, separately from full QA-report completion. No deterministic answer substitution or model judge.
timing_notice: Local agent pipeline at concurrency two. Answer percentiles include emitted structured answers; failures remain in task accuracy and terminal durations. At 15 cases per workflow, empirical p99 is the maximum and is exploratory. Per-task timing starts at its inference admission phase; it excludes campaign waiting during budget reconciliation. Only tasks with zero prior provider usage and no generated content were resumed.
annotation_notice: Developer-authored explicit operational rules and exhaustive scheduling references, not independently adjudicated factory incidents.

admission_history.selection_rule: Only original cases with zero provider usage, no assistant content and explicit admission-cap rejection. Paid and malformed-answer failures are never retried.
